issues.issue: All airport operating functions (disbursements[0]-[5], [7], [9], [11] and matching detail expenditure lines) are in 'other' because no airport/transportation function exists. Defensible, but it puts ~$19.9M of a $25.8M total in 'other', so a person should confirm the function choice.
Farm income on airport land is usually crop-share/farm lease income, which would be 'charges for services/fees' (rentals). It is also printed net of expense. Category is a judgment call.
